definitions.short: a Charodite , or inhabitant of Charod
definitions.full: H2733. Charodi חֲרֹדִי adjective, of location only with article ׳הַח , of Harod 2Sam 23:25 a (see Dr and Judg 7:1 ); = הַהֲרוֺרִי 1Chr 11:27 (read הַהֲרוֺדִי ); also 1Sam 23:25 b but probably not Genuine; not in ᵐ5 or 1Chr 11:27 (see Dr and אֱלִיקָא above).
